method: Review and compose independently recorded, source-backed client call paths. Direct calls are distinguished from static callback wiring and state-dependent composition. Only semantic stages, capture-local resource ordinals and canonical evidence IDs are published.

stages.behavior: The page composer accepts a submitted prompt, coordinates transient response placement and forwards accepted submission state to a completion path.
Completion, regeneration, conditional retry, local function results, work handoff, and answer-now steering converge on a shared generation dispatcher.
The dispatcher invokes the stream service with decoded-event, completion, error, response and recovery callbacks. The transport implements request and topic-resumption alternatives plus cancellation.
An event processor distinguishes message updates from markers and terminal or metadata updates, and routes message updates through batching or replay.
The imported message writer inserts or updates mapping nodes, maintains parent/child links and conditionally rotates descendants; its caller selects the current node.

The scoped state writer commits the mapping/current selected node and updates separate selected-path page/automation references and user-message ancestry. These feature-reference lists are not the transcript.
The conversation page memoizes turn derivation with mapping/current-node and pending/streaming context as explicit dependencies.
The turn preparer constructs typed turn props, conditional pending user input, status/error indicators, timestamp separators and presentation-only first-user hiding.
The virtual list maps derived keyed turns to measured and estimated viewport rows, with overscan, scroll anchoring and targeted restoration.
A page turn-entry component imports the typed renderer; item wrappers emit message roles and source attribution while dispatching user, assistant, tool and media items.

connections.limits: The composer wrapper and dispatcher are source-visible; not every submit-path feature gate is exhaustively audited.
Does not verify any response from a remote server.
Transport callbacks may depend on live feature gates and delivery.
Batching or replay can postpone mutations.
The mapping/current-node state and page memo dependencies are source visible, not a measured React render.
Alternative presentation branches can change which items appear.
Viewport rows are conditional on available geometry.
Offscreen turns may not be mounted.

alternative_paths.name: regeneration
alternative_paths.behavior: A guarded turn control or other regeneration wrapper constructs regeneration input and reuses the generation dispatcher.

alternative_paths.name: user_message_edit
alternative_paths.behavior: A gated user-message edit action resolves the original parent, revalidates after stopping a conflicting response when necessary, and submits a replacement continuation. Server branching semantics are not observed.

alternative_paths.name: response_variant_switch
alternative_paths.behavior: A previous/next variant action selects a filtered candidate descendant, optimistically changes current selection and submits a persistence request; failure can restore the prior selection before the page/viewport recomputes.

alternative_paths.name: response_cancellation
alternative_paths.behavior: A cancellation action unregisters local stream cancellation and delegates a stop/cancel operation to the request layer; remote cancellation success is unknown.

alternative_paths.name: browser_cache
alternative_paths.behavior: Versioned conversation-list metadata and query caches are auxiliary; they are not verified server storage or full message graph persistence.

open_static_questions: Exhaustively resolve dynamic imports for every typed tool/media subrenderer.
Trace all streaming error/retry classifications through error UI and request cleanup.
Confirm whether complete message maps are serialized in any browser-persistent store beyond the versioned list metadata.
Resolve cross-tab synchronization of conversation graphs without attributing unrelated storage listeners.
Identify exact feature gates and hidden-content rendering rules across all item classes.
Map all selected-turn UI controls to request builders and response parsers with field-level invariants.
limits: This is a source-composed lifecycle with reviewed client edges, not a replay or observed execution.
Successful server streaming, message persistence, browser clipboard, scroll motion and other outcomes remain unverified.
An edge marked state dependency composition does not assert an immediate synchronous callback.
The existing optional runtime research proposals do not block captured JavaScript investigation.
No source snippets, wire URLs, browser storage keys, account identifiers, user prompts or copied vendor code are published.
